auto_continue.prompt: Continue autonomously unless blocked by a real ambiguity, approval boundary, or missing external input. Do not ask for confirmation merely to continue. If blocked, report the exact blocker and required input.

version_control.desired_commit_time: After each accepted task, commit only during 20:00-09:00 Europe/Moscow (21:00-10:00 Asia/Tbilisi). Record commit timestamps with the Asia/Tbilisi UTC+04:00 offset. Synthetic future timestamps are allowed, but timestamps must remain strictly monotonic in accepted-task order with at least a one-minute interval between consecutive commits. Push after every accepted task and verify local HEAD equals origin.
